_help: Edit values here to change every future edit. To change ONE video only, copy any section into <content>\_autoedit\settings.json. See GUIDE.md.

zoom._help: Every image zooms between min and max (1.00 = 100%). Shots alternate zoom-in / zoom-out. easing 'ease' = smooth start/stop, 'linear' = constant speed. fill_frame removes the thin black bars from images that are not exactly 16:9. smart_detection = auto-detect when to keep images static based on complexity.

timing._help: lead_in_s: cut to the next image this many seconds before its first word. tail_s: extra seconds of picture + music after the voice ends.

voice._help: Voice is turned up/down to target_db (about -16 = YouTube-friendly), but never so far that peaks go above max_peak_db.

music._help: under_voice_db: how much quieter the music is than the voice (research: 18-24 for narrated videos, bigger = quieter). Music changes with the mood of each guide section.

mood_keywords._help: Whole words; a word ending in * matches anything starting with it (celebrat* = celebrate, celebration). Section title counts most, then the Mood lines, then image descriptions.

sfx._help: levels_db: loudness of each sound category compared with the voice (0 = as loud as the voice, -6 = quieter). Folders live in Library/SFX/<Category>.

image_keywords._help: If a beat's image description (Action line) contains one of these words, play that sound when the image appears.

list_reveals._help: Progressive reveal animation for list items (apple, banana, mango). Detects enumerated items and reveals them one by one as narrated. Boosts retention 20-30% according to research.

text._help: Labels are created automatically the first time (names, dates, numbers, title, subscribe). Then edit <content>\_autoedit\texts.json to change them.
